classes.voice-conflict: One Meaning holds both a 피동사 and a 사동사 sense (opposite voice) of the same verb; the canonical gloss itself carries both markers.
classes.homonym-unrelated-merge: One Meaning joins two STDICT homonym entries whose senses share no core (글씨 쓰기 vs 음식 먹기).
classes.reference-target-merge: One Meaning joins `→` pointer senses whose targets differ.
classes.sound-source-merge: Onomatopoeia Meaning joins senses whose sound source or affect differs, while sibling lemmas (꿀꿀, 꼴꼴, 꽁꽁, 꺽꺽) split by source.
classes.slang-referent-merge: Slang/은어 senses naming different referents joined (or joined into a plain-language sense) while 꽁이 and 꽃 split the same pattern.
classes.different-referent-merge: One Meaning joins senses with unrelated referents of the same surface form.
classes.over-split-candidate: Separate Meanings whose senses may be a natural extension of one lexical identity.
classes.gloss-identity-loss: Meaning gloss abstracts away a source-bound distinguishing detail.
classes.source-defect: Canonical source gloss is itself defective (blank quotation).
classes.valid-contrast: Correct merge/split kept as a counter-example for the proposed rules.

annotations.evidence: Canonical glosses mark both `의 피동사` and `의 사동사` inside one Meaning (깎이다 w53304 vs w403510; 까불리다 w53709 vs w403730; 깨다 w54686 vs w54688; 껴묻히다 w54452 vs w54453; 꿇리다 w56077 vs w406391).

Each Meaning joins `글씨나 그림 따위를 아무렇게나 쓰거나 그리다` with `달갑지 않은 음식을 억지로 굼뜨게 먹다`(깨지락거리다 준말). Sibling lemmas 깨지락거리다, 깨질거리다, 께적거리다 hold only the eating/slow-act sense, so the writing sense is the foreign element.
깨이다 joins `→ 깎이다01`(깎아지다) with `→ 줄어지다`; 깨보숭이 joins `→ 깨고물` with `→ 깨소금`. The targets are different lexical items, and 깨보숭이's sibling m55654 shows a third referent.

Pointer senses with different targets share one Meaning (깜보기 꽁초/깜부기, 깡뚱 깡똥01/02, 깨적거리다 깨작거리다02/께적거리다, 꼬망지 꼬리/꼴찌, 끄스르다·끄슬리다·끄시르다 그슬리다01/그을리다01, 끊치다 그치다/끊어지다, 꾀이다 꾀다01/02/03). Some targets are near-synonyms, so confirmation needs the target Meanings.
annotations.direction: hold: compare target Meaning identity before deciding

annotations.evidence: 꼬시레 joins the noun and interjection entries of one word (고수레02Ⅰ/Ⅱ); 꼭두 joins 곡두01 and 허깨비, which share one referent; 꼲다 joins `→ 꼬느다01` with the sense that 꼬느다 itself carries (m54272). Pointer merges are correct when the targets share the referent.
One Meaning joins three to five sounds with different sources (물 삼킴/숨 끊김/물체 바닥 뒤집힘; 배 끓음/닭 놀람/액체 통과/가래/기체 방울). Siblings 꿀꿀, 꼴꼴, 꽁꽁, 꺽꺽, 꾹꾹 split by source.
annotations.direction: decide one source rule and apply to every 의성어 family

annotations.evidence: Each Meaning joins a laughing sense with a baby's crying sense (까르르·까르륵), a 앓는 소리 with a puppy's bark (깽 family), or belching with a choking sound (꺽). The source text calls them one sound quality, but the affect or source differs.
깽깽 joins `→ 깨깨01`(아이 우는 소리) with 앓는 소리/강아지 소리; 깔딱·깔딱깔딱 join `→ 딸꾹`/`→ 딸꾹딸꾹` pointer senses with the three sounds.
까바리(밥그릇/깡통), 꼰대(늙은이/선생님), 깔깔이(조젯/새 돈), 꽃씨(화초 씨앗/성냥 황 은어) each join slang senses with different referents. 꽁이 (수갑/열쇠) and 꽃 (은어 불·성냥 vs 식물) are split.
annotations.direction: REPARTITION candidate; confirm against one slang rule

annotations.evidence: 꼬이다/꾀다 (속이다 + 벌레 모이다), 까부라지다, 깐 (가늠 + 한 것치고는), 꽃노래 (별신굿 거리 + 민요), 까치놀 (노을 + 흰 물결), 꺽두/꺽두기 (가죽신 + 나막신 은어), 끼다 (끼우다·끼이다 준말 혼합), 꿇다, 꼴리다, 끝빨다, 깡깡, 깡똥하다, 껑청, 께끼다, 꿍치다 each join senses whose relation needs a lexical-identity argument the data does not state.
Each Meaning joins `병·통 속 액체가 흔들리는 소리` with `착 붙지 않고 들떠 부푼 모양`.

깜짝/끔쩍 split `눈 감겼다 뜨임` from `놀람` while the 깜박 and 껌벅 families merge eye, light and memory; 꺽꺽 splits 장끼 울음 from the throat-block sound; 껴얹다 keeps a pointer-only Meaning beside a Meaning with a different sense. Each could be a natural extension of one identity or two homonyms.
annotations.direction: hold: needs a rule for sense-extension vs homonym

annotations.evidence: 꺽쇠 gloss `북청 사자놀음이나 남사당패 탈놀이에 나오는 인물 또는 그 인물이 쓰는 탈` drops the source distinction between w53171-s1 (양반의 하인, 분홍 바탕에 수염이 달린 탈) and w53171-s2 (엷은 자주 바탕, 검은 눈썹·수염·주름살·붉은 입술). The same mask text sits in m404221 under lemma 꼭.
annotations.direction: gloss fix; also re-check whether two characters share one identity

annotations.evidence: The 속담 glosses replace the two source meanings with one abstract sentence (`함부로 판단해서는 안 된다`).
w404250-s1 `‘’을 속되게 이르는 말.` carries a blank quotation in canonical, and the Meaning copies it. Fix belongs to canonical, not Meaning.
